_comment: YouTube Shorts posting settings. Uploads are driven through YouTube Studio with Playwright using your exported Google session cookies (Netscape format) in data/youtube_cookies.txt - see scripts/setup.ps1. backend: 'studio' (default, Playwright + cookies) or 'api' (official YouTube Data API v3 - pip install "ttclips[api]", save a Desktop OAuth client JSON to client_secrets_file, then run ttclips-youtube --auth once; note unaudited API projects can only upload private videos). token_file: where the API refresh token is stored. headless: keep false if Studio refuses to load the upload dialog. channel_id: optional - your channel id (UC...) speeds up navigation to the upload page. cookies_file: path to the exported cookies (Netscape format) from a logged-in studio.youtube.com session. visibility: public|unlisted|private. made_for_kids: false. category_id: 27 = Entertainment. default_hashtags: appended to every Short. include_source_link: adds the original YouTube URL to the description of reposts. max_duration_sec: 180 - the Shorts limit. selectors: override any Studio selector here if YouTube changes its markup (a comma-separated string or a list of alternatives).
